description: "Sketches and Studies" by Nathaniel Hawthorne is a collection of biographical sketches and essays written during the mid-19th century. The opening chapter focuses on the life of Franklin Pierce, the 14th President of the United States, offering an outline of his origins, early life, and political ascension.
